class.name: CbBody
class.brief_description: What a body is: what it weighs, how it grips, how it bounces. The base of [CbProp] and [CbItem].
class.description: Not a node to place. A map's prop and an item are both a body in the world, so both say it the same way, here. A [CbTemplate] says the same three through its Material component. The simulation uses them on the server and in every client alike: what a body weighs decides how a player's push, a hook's pull and a rope share with it; friction and bounce are Box3D's.

members.member: Kilograms. 0: its volume times [member density]. (A [CbItem] starts at 1.)
Kilograms per cubic metre, used when [member mass] is 0: at 40, a crate 1 m across is 40 kg.
How it grips what it touches: 0 is ice, 0.6 the usual, more holds harder.
How much of a hit it gives back: 0 does not bounce, 1 loses nothing.
